metadata.title: When Valorant Hands You 2 Kills for Doing Nothing and You're Still Confused
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get gifted kills for free? 
Enemy probably paused to rethink life choices.
Click if your aim is a mess but the scoreboard still loves you.
Valorant logic is wild, but I’m not complaining.

Tap if you ever won fights by pure accident!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
